*🧭 Review & outlook*
Week in review – USD & majors:
The US Dollar Index gained +0.39% to 102.28, supported by strong US payrolls that prompted Fed policymakers to consider rate hikes while extreme euro shorts met dollar strength. USD/CAD led dollar gains (+1.13%), AUD/USD was the weakest major (-2.29%), and USD/CHF proved most resilient (-0.44%). European markets digested ECB leadership developments between Knot and De Cos as Lagarde warned that inflation is likely to stay high.

Week in review – Gold:
Gold gained +4.51% to finish at 4,074.9, holding above $4,000 despite a strong jobs beat and Goldman lowering its price forecast on a hawkish Fed shift. Bullion found support from US-Iran conflict developments and post-midterms market volatility.

Week in review – Oil:
Crude plunged as Brent fell -16.42% to 98.32 and WTI lost -12.76% to 90.83 after the US eased Russia oil sanctions to tame prices and markets weighed Middle East settlement prospects. The sell-off unfolded despite US strikes on Iran's Kharg Island, Strait of Hormuz tanker fires, and Iraq requesting an increased OPEC quota.

Week in review – Risk mood:
Equities tumbled as the S&P 500 dropped -2.68% to 7,377 and the VIX surged +32.03% to 25.64 on AI concerns and post-election market routs. US 10-year Treasury yields fell -1.42% over the week to 4.859%.

Week in review – Political risk:
The US midterm elections drove cross-asset swings across equities, yields, and currencies. Geopolitical tensions escalated through US strikes on Iran's Kharg Island and tanker fires in Hormuz, though crude dropped on temporary US-Russia sanctions relief.

Week ahead – Key events:
Monday 09 Nov: GBP BOE Gov Bailey Speaks - guides Sterling expectations amid UK inflation pressures.
Tuesday 10 Nov: USD CPI m/m - core inflation reading shaping Fed rate hike expectations and the dollar.
Thursday 12 Nov: GBP Prelim GDP q/q - gauges UK economic momentum and policy flexibility.
Thursday 12 Nov: USD Unemployment Claims - tests labor strength following the payrolls beat.
Friday 13 Nov: EUR ECB President Lagarde Speaks - sets eurozone monetary tone amid sticky inflation warnings.
Friday 13 Nov: USD PPI m/m - signals wholesale pipeline price pressures for Fed policy.

Week ahead – Political events:
Middle East conflict: Strikes on Iranian sites and Hormuz disruptions channel into crude risk premiums and safe-haven gold demand.
US-Russia oil deal: Eased sanctions on Russian oil channel directly into crude price benchmarks and refining spreads.
OPEC production requests: Iraq tapping OPEC for quota increases channels into global supply balances and energy pricing.
COP31 summit: Climate conference channels into broader fossil fuel demand sentiment and electrification trends.

Week ahead – Themes & risks:
FX: US CPI will dictate whether USD/JPY tests 160 or if EUR/USD tests its multi-week lows.
Gold: XAU/USD balances hawkish Fed rate expectations against supportive geopolitical tensions.
Oil: Crude faces heightened volatility between Middle East supply risks and downside pressure from eased Russian sanctions.
